query:
The family reached an agreement about how often Emeka would attend family gatherings going forward. What did the group decide, and what specifically in how Emeka responded to that decision reveals how he actually felt about committing to it?

Options:
A. Emeka
B. Adaeze
C. Tobenna
D. Chisom
context:
[1] (about=Emeka, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:10:00) Fine. One gathering per quarter from next year. I can commit to that.
[2] (about=Chisom, episodic, t4 @2025-11-02T18:12:00) QUARTERLY?? Emeka who are you and what have you done with my brother 😭😭 I'm actually screaming
[3] (about=GROUP, said_by=Emeka, group-interaction, t4 @2025-11-02T17:52:00) Emeka commits to one family gathering per quarter from next year.
[4] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t14 @2025-12-07T17:36:00) Adaeze will create a running order: video call with Obiageli at 11am, food from 2pm, Emeka's arrival by 12; to be circulated by Friday.
[5] (about=Emeka, episodic, t6 @2025-11-09T20:02:00) Mum. You are absolutely coming. I will collect you from Reading. We will make a weekend of it.
agent_answer:
The group decided that Emeka would attend **one family gathering per quarter, starting next year**.

Emeka’s own response was: *“Fine. One gathering per quarter from next year. I can commit to that.”* The “Fine” and “I can commit” already sound reluctant. But the person whose reaction **reveals how he actually felt** is **D. Chisom** — she exclaims, *“QUARTERLY?? Emeka who are you and what have you done with my brother 😭😭”* — showing that agreeing to this is completely out of character for Emeka and that he likely accepted it only grudgingly.
